تموضعت (form IIq)
# تَمَوْضَعْتُ (tamawḍaʕtu) /ta.maw.dˤaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
# تَمَوْضَعْتَ (tamawḍaʕta) /ta.maw.dˤaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
# تَمَوْضَعْتِ (tamawḍaʕti) /ta.maw.dˤaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
# تَمَوْضَعَتْ (tamawḍaʕat) /ta.maw.dˤa.ʕat
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
